recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future expansion of Observation value search parameters should be handled by a new OO search-parameter issue rather than by treating FHIR-11087 as still unapplied.
issue_request: FHIR-11087 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 OO request to add Observation searches that target only Observation.code or Observation.value[x], plus separate searches for only Observation.component.code or Observation.component.value[x], because combined direct/component search fields made code/value matches ambiguous.
initial_application: Historical commit 4d575fe47df8dfb6915328e0ab1dfb774f2f322c, with message [#11087], changed the old Observation spreadsheet source to make direct code/value parameters observation-only, add combo-* parameters for the prior combined behavior, and add component-* and component-code-value-* parameters. The source was later refactored from spreadsheet rows into source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-9734 had earlier merged Observation.code with Observation.component.code, and FHIR-11088 separately addressed computable composite Observation search parameters. The current active bundle defines code, combo-code, component-code, observation-only value and code-value parameters, component concept/quantity value and code-value parameters, and combo concept/quantity parameters. The original 2017 application also included component/combo string and date variants, but later FHIR-17789 specifically revisited missing Observation value variants, including combo-* and component-* string/date parameters, and ended as Resolved - No Change after OO determined the topic had been overcome by subsequent search-parameter work.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current accepted direct/component split is already in the active source, while reintroducing omitted component/combo string and date variants would conflict with the later FHIR-17789 no-change disposition.
